column1: # Disjoint 120-pair universe, zero overlap with universe 1, 1m detail restored.
# Sized from measurement: a 272-pair run peaked at ~11.4GB against ~4-6GB typically
# available and was OOM-killed repeatedly. At ~43MB/pair, 120 pairs projects to ~5GB.
# Dropping --timeframe-detail 1m was tried first and did NOT help (11.54 -> 11.37GB),
# so the memory is NFI computing indicators over pairs x 5 timeframes, not 1m data.
# Zero overlap is also a cleaner rule-4 test than 272 pairs sharing 43 with universe 1.
